title: Permitted combination waste and vent system.
officialText:
A combination waste and vent piping system, limited for use as a means of
venting the traps of floor drains and laboratory sinks, shall be permitted in conjunction with horizontal branch waste pipin g of an
independent flammable oil waste system or acid waste systems, and as described under indirect wastes and special wastes.
